audio.text: When is the next inventory count?
Ask Ms. Lee, she has the calendar.

options: Ask Ms. Lee, she has the calendar.

why.vi: Trả lời gián tiếp: không nói ngày mà chỉ người biết ('Ask Ms. Lee').
why.en: An indirect answer: it points to the person who knows.

questions.trap: (A) lặp count nhưng nghĩa khác; (B) trả lời Where.

audio.text: Where should I put these boxes?
Let me check where there's space.

options: Let me check where there's space.

why.vi: Trả lời gián tiếp: chưa biết, sẽ kiểm tra chỗ trống.
why.en: An indirect answer: the speaker will check for space first.

questions.trap: (A) lặp chủ đề boxes nhưng không chỉ chỗ đặt.

audio.text: How much will the repairs cost?

why.vi: Chưa có con số; 'waiting for the estimate' là trả lời gián tiếp.
why.en: There is no figure yet, so waiting for the estimate is an indirect answer.

questions.trap: (B) trả lời When, không phải How much.

audio.text: You should ask the HR department.
Yes, it was a nice vacation.

options: You should ask the HR department.
Yes, it was a nice vacation.

why.vi: Khuyên hỏi bộ phận khác là trả lời gián tiếp hợp lệ.
why.en: Pointing to the HR department is a valid indirect answer.

questions.trap: (A) lặp chủ đề nghỉ phép nhưng trả lời How long.

audio.text: Is the conference room available at three?
Let me look at the booking calendar.

options: Let me look at the booking calendar.

why.vi: Chưa biết nên đi kiểm tra lịch: trả lời gián tiếp.
why.en: The speaker will check the calendar, an indirect answer.

questions.trap: (B) nghe giống three nhưng nói số máy tính.

audio.text: Why was the flight to Hanoi cancelled?

why.vi: Chưa nghe chi tiết: 'I haven't heard' là cách đáp phổ biến.
why.en: 'I haven't heard the details' is a common way to say 'I don't know'.

questions.trap: (B) có Yes nên không hợp với câu hỏi Why.

audio.text: What time does the aquarium café open for school groups?
I opened it with a key.

options: I opened it with a key.

why.vi: Chỉ nơi có thông tin: 'It's on the website'.
why.en: Pointing to where the information is posted is an indirect answer.

questions.trap: (A) lặp open nhưng nói việc đã làm.

audio.text: Where is the new intern sitting?

why.vi: Chưa gặp nên không biết: trả lời gián tiếp.
why.en: Not having met her means the speaker does not know.

questions.trap: (A) lặp sit nhưng là câu mời.

audio.text: Have you received the updated contract?
The contract is for two years.

options: The contract is for two years.

why.vi: Trả lời gián tiếp: để trợ lý xử lý thư nên chưa rõ.
why.en: The assistant handles the mail, so the speaker cannot confirm.

questions.trap: (A) lặp contract nhưng nói thời hạn.

audio.text: Let's see how many are left first.

options: Let's see how many are left first.

why.vi: Muốn kiểm tra số lượng còn lại trước khi quyết định.
why.en: The speaker wants to check the stock before deciding.

questions.trap: (B) lặp brochures nhưng không phản hồi đề nghị.

audio.text: Do you want to take the early or the late train?
It depends on when the meeting ends.

options: It depends on when the meeting ends.

why.vi: 'It depends on...' là cách đáp gián tiếp cho câu hỏi chọn.
why.en: 'It depends on...' is an indirect reply to a choice question.

questions.trap: (A) lặp late nhưng là Yes.

audio.text: How long will the tank repairs take?
The technician hasn't told us yet.

options: The technician hasn't told us yet.

why.vi: Chưa có thông tin từ kỹ thuật viên: trả lời gián tiếp.
why.en: There is no information yet from the technician.

questions.trap: (B) trả lời Where.

audio.text: Why hasn't the new software been installed?

why.vi: Khuyên hỏi bộ phận IT: gián tiếp nhưng hợp lý.
why.en: Sending the asker to IT is a reasonable indirect answer.

questions.trap: (B) lặp install nhưng không giải thích lý do.

audio.text: Who is replacing Mr. Ito on the project?

why.vi: Chưa quyết định: một câu trả lời gián tiếp phổ biến.
why.en: 'That hasn't been decided' is a common indirect answer.

questions.trap: (C) lặp project nhưng nói về thời hạn.

audio.text: What's the plan for the Friday event?
Check the email I sent yesterday.
Plans are available at the front desk.

options: Check the email I sent yesterday.
Plans are available at the front desk.

why.vi: Chỉ sang email đã gửi: trả lời gián tiếp.
why.en: Pointing to a previous email is an indirect answer.

questions.trap: (C) lặp plan nhưng không nói đúng việc cần biết.

audio.text: Is the museum free for students?
Their website lists all the prices.

options: Their website lists all the prices.

why.vi: Gợi ý xem website thay vì trả lời trực tiếp.
why.en: Suggesting the website is an indirect answer.

questions.trap: (A) lặp students nhưng nói giờ đến.

audio.text: Can you work the split shift next Tuesday?
Let me check my other plans first.

options: Let me check my other plans first.

why.vi: Cần kiểm tra lịch khác: trả lời gián tiếp. Split shift là ca làm bị chia làm hai đoạn.
why.en: The speaker needs to check other plans first; a split shift is a workday divided in two parts.

questions.trap: (C) lặp split nhưng nghĩa khác (chia tiền).

audio.text: Did you see the memo about the cleanliness inspection?
I haven't checked my inbox this morning.
The clean room is on the left.

options: I haven't checked my inbox this morning.
The clean room is on the left.

why.vi: Chưa mở hộp thư nên chưa xem: trả lời gián tiếp.
why.en: Not having checked the inbox implies not having seen the memo.

questions.trap: (B) nghe giống clean nhưng chỉ chỗ.

audio.text: Where do I submit the travel receipts?
The finance team sent instructions last week.
By the end of the month.

options: The finance team sent instructions last week.
By the end of the month.

why.vi: Chỉ đến hướng dẫn của bộ phận tài chính thay vì nói nơi nộp.
why.en: It points to finance's instructions rather than naming a place.

questions.trap: (C) trả lời When.

audio.text: Would you rather start now or wait until the manager arrives?
I'd rather have the window seat.

options: I'd rather have the window seat.

why.vi: Hỏi ngược lại là một cách trả lời gián tiếp ở mức khó.
why.en: A question in return is a harder kind of indirect reply.

questions.trap: (B) lặp 'I'd rather' nhưng sang chủ đề khác.
